events.description: Final day highlights as the DP World Tour season reaches its climax. The winner of the Race to Dubai is crowned, with Northern Ireland’s Rory McIlroy having won the last four editions. McIlroy has won seven Race to Dubai titles, putting him one behind Colin Montgomerie’s all-time record. Spain’s Engenio Chacarra has enjoyed an incredible breakout season, and the USA’s Patrick Reed is firmly in the mix with two wins to his name. Open champion Ryan Fox and PGA champion Aaron Rai also tee it up on the Earth Course at Jumeirah Golf Estates in Dubai. The top ten DP World Tour members not already exempt will earn a PGA Tour card for the 2027 season. Presenter - Sarah Mulkerrins Editor - Jamie Gavin.
